summary: Selects a render flag mode from the a3 flag mask and records the incoming value a2 into one of two render value fields on the object: bit 0x800 stores a2 at +0x234 and ORs 0x800 into the accumulated flags word at +0x3C; bit 0x1000 stores a2 at +0x238 and ORs 0x1000 into the flags word at +0x3C. Returns a3 unchanged when neither flag bit is set.

operations.description: result is initialized to a3 (the render flag mask).
When bit 0x800 of a3 is set the 0x800 branch runs; otherwise the 0x1000 branch is tested next.
0x800 branch: stores the value a2 into the render value field at +0x234 (this[141]).
0x800 branch: ORs bit 0x800 into the accumulated render flags word at +0x3C (this[15]) and sets result to a2.
When bit 0x1000 of a3 is set (and 0x800 was not) the 0x1000 branch runs.
0x1000 branch: stores the value a2 into the render value field at +0x238 (this[142]).
0x1000 branch: result becomes the flags word at +0x3C (this[15]) ORed with 0x1000, and that combined value is written back into the flags word.
Returns result: a3 unchanged when neither flag bit is set, a2 in the 0x800 branch, and the ORed flags word in the 0x1000 branch.

clean_pseudocode: else if (a3 & 0x1000) { this[142] = a2; result = this[15] | 0x1000; this[15] = result; }
